# mile marker

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mileMarker`](gmeow-mileMarker.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mileMarker>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A linear-referencing mile-marker or chainage — a distance-along-a-line coordinate on a linear feature such as a road, railway, or pipeline (e.g. '42.3'). The unit and direction are solver-layer attributes ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), or may be declared via [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:mileMarker`](gmeow-mileMarker.md) from [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a linear-referencing mile-marker / chainage on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) — distance along a road, railway, or pipeline.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it off a linear feature and avoid omitting unit/direction context (solver-layer or [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:mileMarker`](gmeow-mileMarker.md) on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) whose [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) is [`gmeow:referenceFrameMileMarker`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameMileMarker.md).

### Examples

- ex:mmLoc [`gmeow:mileMarker`](gmeow-mileMarker.md) "42.3".
